evidence: Read the actual workbook quality row 3 and matching internal annotation, then manually proofread all 15 brief lines and both public notes (19 and 431 lines). No real spelling error, accidental author aside, foreign workstation path, or duplicated prose was found. A local Python scan for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|<placeholder>, Windows drive paths, /Users/, /home/, and replacement characters returned no hits; repeated paragraphs were only intentional Markdown separators. Template CHANGE_ME content is absent from the task. In the frozen task, instruction.md:7,9,13 consistently identifies the two note paths, /app/server.js, /assets/seed_data.json, /app/app.db and startup seeding; integration.md:3-19 agrees. instruction.md:15 matches all seven seed accounts and authority tiers. hireops_rules.md:60-68 uses one reference moment, matching seed reference_moment 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z, and explicitly separates rescission effective dates. Seed constants agree with rules sections 2, 3, 6 and 7; the described seven requisitions, four departments, three employees and DRAFT/PENDING/COMMITTED seed statuses also agree. Adversarial reading: an app using the fixed reference moment for rescission cannot exploit contradictory clocks because rules:66-68 and 273-287 explicitly require the effective date; a conforming app using four-year equity annualization with the separate 32-month vesting schedule is allowed by rules:121-124 and 329-342.
